document-search.title: Search information across large document volumes
document-search.description: Query contracts, specs, and archives in natural language — sourced answers in seconds.
document-search.detail: We index your document bases (SharePoint, Drive, ERP), wire a cited RAG engine, and your teams ask questions without hours of searching. Shipped in short sprints with access rights preserved.

payment-reconciliation.title: Reconcile payments and invoices with precision
payment-reconciliation.description: Automatically match receipts to invoices and cut manual mismatches.
payment-reconciliation.detail: OCR pipelines plus business rules to match bank feeds and invoices. Ambiguous cases go to a human; the rest runs continuously into your ERP.

prospect-outreach.title: Identify prospects and reach out automatically
prospect-outreach.description: Score accounts, personalize the first touch, and run outreach from the CRM.
prospect-outreach.detail: Enrichment, scoring, and outreach sequences wired into your CRM. Messages stay personal; sales only pick up warm replies.

rfp-automation.title: Automate tender and RFP responses
rfp-automation.description: Extract requirements, pre-fill dossiers, and speed up RFP replies.
rfp-automation.detail: Requirement extraction, mapping to your answer library, and dossier pre-fill. The team reviews, tunes tone, and submits faster.

contract-check.title: Review contracts and legal documents
contract-check.description: Check clauses, dates, and inconsistencies before signing or filing.
contract-check.detail: Automatic review of critical clauses, dates, and inconsistencies. Every alert is traceable so legal focuses on real risk.

support-chatbot.title: Automate customer support with a chatbot
support-chatbot.description: Answer frequent requests 24/7 and escalate complex cases to the team.
support-chatbot.detail: An assistant on your knowledge base and tickets. It clears repetitive volume, escalates cleanly, and leaves a trail for support.

solar-cv.title: Detect and map assets with computer vision
solar-cv.description: Spot roofs, parking lots, and energy assets from satellite or drone imagery.
solar-cv.detail: Vision models on satellite / drone imagery to detect roofs, shading, and usable surfaces. Results mapped and exportable to field tools.

technical-docs.title: Industrialize technical documentation
technical-docs.description: Generate and refresh manuals, procedures, and quality files from your sources.
technical-docs.detail: Generate and refresh manuals from existing sources (Git, Notion, specs). Versioning, templates, and human review on critical passages.

returns-automation.title: Automate returns handling
returns-automation.description: Qualify returns, trigger credits, and sync inventory with support.
returns-automation.detail: Qualify reasons, trigger credits, and sync inventory / OMS. Fewer manual tickets, more visibility for support and logistics.

lease-extraction.title: Extract and verify leases and tenant files
lease-extraction.description: Structure lease data and flag gaps before validation.
lease-extraction.detail: OCR plus structured lease extraction. Missing or inconsistent fields are flagged before business validation.

lead-scoring.title: Score leads and prioritize the pipeline
lead-scoring.description: Rank CRM opportunities so sales focus on the right moment.
lead-scoring.detail: Live CRM scoring from product signals, engagement, and fit. Teams see who to prioritize and why — without a parallel spreadsheet.

faq.question: What is an AI audit?
faq.answer: An AI audit is a short diagnosis of your processes and data to find where AI actually creates value. At RADIANZ, we map use cases, estimate ROI and feasibility, then prioritize a roadmap. You know what to launch, and what to leave aside.

faq.question: How long does an AI audit take?
faq.answer: The RADIANZ AI audit runs in one week. After a discovery workshop, we map use cases, analyze opportunities, and deliver a prioritized roadmap with an actionable report. No radio silence until delivery: you get concrete deliverables by the end of the week.

faq.question: Who is this AI audit for?
faq.answer: This AI audit is for founders, CIOs, and ops leads who need clear priorities before investing. Useful if you have too many AI ideas and too few results, or need an actionable roadmap. Startup, SMB, or mid-market: the format stays short and concrete.

faq.question: What do you deliver at the end of the audit?
faq.answer: You walk away with a discovery workshop, AI use case mapping, opportunity analysis, a quick-wins roadmap, and an actionable audit report. All of it in one week, at no cost. Deliverables you can use right away, not a decorative slide deck.

faq.question: How is this different from classic AI consulting?
faq.answer: Classic consulting often produces slides and broad recommendations. Our AI audit cuts through: prioritized cases, real feasibility on your stack, quick-wins roadmap. We build like founders, in short sprints. If you move forward, we start the build. If not, you keep a clear plan.

audit.ctaDescription: 15 minutes to see if a one-week audit makes sense for you. No catalog pitch.
